title: 26 February 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
content:
The Beatles filmed a number of scenes for Help! in the Bahamas on this day, in a shoot lasting from 8.30am-5.30pm on New Providence Island.

Ringo Starr appeared in scenes in the yacht basin and in front of the post office on Bay Street, Nassau. He also appeared with George Harrison in the kapok treehouse in the Royal Victoria Hotel gardens.

John Lennon was filmed running out of the public library shouting for Ringo, and a number of scenes not featuring The Beatles were also shot for the prison camp sequences, at Lake Cunningham.

Page last updated: 15 May 2010

  • 1963: The Beatles live: Gaumont Cinema, Taunton
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Kingsway Club, Southport
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
